UNITED STATES OF AMERICA 
BEFORE THE 
FEDERAL ENERGY REGULATORY COMMISSION 
 
PJM Interconnection, L.L.C. 
) 
Docket No. ER26-3515-000 
 
ANSWER OF 
EAST KENTUCKY POWER COOPERATIVE, INC. TO 
MOTION FOR EXTENSION OF TIME TO FILE COMMENTS 
 
Pursuant to Rule 213 of the Commission’s Rules of Practice and Procedure1 and the August 
31, 2026 Notice Shortening Answer Period in this proceeding,2 East Kentucky Power Cooperative, 
Inc. (“EKPC”)3 submits this Answer in support of the Motion for Extension of Time filed by the 
Organization of PJM States, Inc. (“OPSI”).4 In this proceeding, PJM Interconnection, L.L.C. 
(“PJM”) has proposed revisions to its Open Access Transmission Tariff (“Tariff”) and Reliability 
Assurance Agreement Among Load Serving Entities (“RAA”) to implement Interim Resource 
Adequacy Service (“IRAS”). PJM’s proposal is complex and materially different from the 
“Connect and Manage” (the predecessor to IRAS) proposal considered in the stakeholder process. 
Allowing participants additional time to review PJM’s proposal and provide substantive comments 
will provide for a more thorough and complete record for the Commission to review as it considers 
PJM’s proposal. An extension of time to September 14, 2026 is reasonable given the complexities 
of PJM’s proposal, and the requested extension is consistent with Commission precedent in recent 
 
1 18 C.F.R. § 385.213 (2026). 
2 PJM Interconnection, L.L.C., “Notice Shortening Answer Period,” Docket No. ER26-3515-000 (Aug. 31, 2026).  
3 EKPC filed a doc-less motion to intervene in this proceeding on August 18, 2026. 
4 PJM Interconnection, L.L.C., “Motion for Extension of Time of The Organization of PJM States, Inc.,” Docket No. 
ER26-3515-000 (filed Aug. 28, 2026) (“Motion”).

2 
proceedings that involve similarly complex issues.5 Therefore, EKPC respectfully requests that the 
Commission grant OPSI’s request for an extension of the comment deadline in this proceeding.
